reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that enables configured vision-model analysis of uploaded images and videos, with video processing and a web UI panel for viewing results.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加图像和视频分析能力，将媒体发送到配置的兼容视觉模型，并在 Web 侧边栏展示结果。
summaries.en: Adds image and video analysis to DeepSeek Harness by sending media to a configured compatible vision model and displaying results in a web sidebar.

capabilities: Reads uploaded images and videos for analysis
Sends image data and extracted video frames to a configured OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint
Uses FFmpeg, FFprobe, and PySceneDetect for video normalization and scene detection when available
Adds a right-side web panel and a vision_describe tool for reviewing and querying media analysis
